title: Use Completed namespace during refresh
summary: Routed broad refresh and Current Output Status refresh through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.renderCompleted after the Completed flat render export was removed.
reason: The WebView refresh paths still called the removed flat renderCompleted global, which could abort refresh before Settings builders populated saved values.
behavior_before: refreshAllNow and refreshCurrentOutputStatus called bare renderCompleted(...). With no flat window.renderCompleted export, a refresh could fail in the Completed renderer and leave later surfaces, including Settings fields, stale or blank.
behavior_after: Both refresh paths call window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.renderCompleted through the existing Completed namespace. The flat export remains removed, and missing namespace state fails closed without restoring a compatibility global.
tests_added: Extended tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert refresh callers use mediaPipelineCompletedView.renderCompleted and no longer call the flat renderCompleted global.
rollback_plan: Revert the two namespace call replacements and the static assertions, then refresh generated summaries. This restores the prior flat-global refresh dependency but does not touch settings files, media, queue, publish, or source paths.
notes: Config diagnosis: C:/Users/lmmye/AppData/Local/MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO/MediaPipeline_config.psd1 imports cleanly and still contains SourceMovies, SourceTV, Outsource, LocalBase, RobocopyFlags, SkipStabilityCheck, EnableIntegrityCheck, and LibraryProfiles. The visible blank Settings fields are consistent with the frontend refresh exception rather than a PSD1 parse failure. No settings persistence, backend route, media, source, queue, publish, drain, or filesystem mutation behavior changed.
